scope: Isolated daily credit and funding research; no trading, broker, allocator or scheduler integration
evidence: Retrospective source audit plus synthetic correctness scenarios; no demonstrated early-warning or trading advantage
threshold_status: Untuned illustrative research rules, not calibrated probabilities or validated risk limits
availability: Use explicit timezone-aware eligible_at, never accounting period end. Date-only disclosures enter at next local midnight as a conservative research convention, not a verified first-arrival timestamp. Current-vintage history cannot enter earlier dates.
funding_accounting: One currency and legally usable cash pool per run. Operating cash flow is net of baseline interest and operating leases. Only incremental rate shocks are added. No automatic transfer between parent and subsidiary pools. Debt repayments and finance-lease principal counted separately once.
facility_policy: Only verified committed drawable capacity in the same pool; total capacity consumed once; collateral/access haircut applied to capacity; requested financing is not cash
missing_data: UNKNOWN; no equity or broad-credit substitution for unavailable issuer credit
index_transmission: Issuer stress alone never changes the SPY assessment; broad credit plus separately qualified equity breadth required
future_validation: Compare price-only, price-plus-broad-credit and issuer-enriched rules on identical point-in-time coverage, fixed costs and untouched issuer/period holdouts. No outcome metrics without qualified inputs and an explicit exposure policy.
